patches.title: Common Sense Object Location
patches.principle: Begin search at the furniture type where the object is normally stored (e.g., soapbar on shelf, spoon in drawer).
patches.when_to_apply: When starting a task that requires finding a specific household object.

patches.title: Examine Open Surfaces First
patches.principle: Before opening closed containers, examine all open surfaces (countertops, tables, shelves) for the target object.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and open surfaces are nearby.

patches.title: Direct Transformation Then Placement
patches.principle: After cleaning, heating, or cooling the object, go immediately to the target location and place it without wandering.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have just transformed the object and the destination is known.
